products.title: Zarina
products.body_html:
PRODUCT:
Penélope Luz believes that painting your nails isn't just for decoration — it's also therapy, self-care, and a way to express yourself while showing the world who you are. We believe that a bottle filled with art and sparkle can lift your mood, make your heart race, and help you feel just how special you truly are. Our goal is to bring art, beauty, and exclusivity in the form of nail polishes.

DESCRIPTION:
Magnetic silver with orange/gold shimmer. 10ml (0.33 fl oz).
This magnetic nail polish needs a magnet to create the pattern. The magnet is not included with the polish.
Zarina is 10-free — free from the 10 main substances that may cause allergies.

INSPIRATION:
The nail polish Zarina is part of the Fly to Your Heart Collection, and is inspired by the animated film Tinker Bell, a classic that has charmed generations with its message of self-love and self-acceptance.

HOW TO APPLY:
For best results when applying this polish, follow these steps:
1. Moisturize and gently push back your cuticles.
2. Apply a base coat.
